obligations.title: Provide requested staffing and recruitment services with suitably qualified Personnel.
Provide timely access to information, premises, systems and decision-makers.
Remove and replace Personnel the Customer reasonably objects to.
Ensure Personnel are legally entitled to work in the location of performance.
Keep the other party's Confidential Information confidential and use it only for the Services.
Assign all rights in Deliverables to Customer and procure Personnel assignments.
Process personal information only on Customer's documented instructions.
Implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures for personal information.
Ensure persons authorised to process personal information are bound by confidentiality.
Assist Customer in responding to lawful requests from individuals and regulators.
Return or delete Customer personal information on request at termination or expiry.
Return or delete the other party's Confidential Information on request after termination or expiry.
